slides.title: Just moved to Laval? Set up these 5 things.
slides.sub: Bins, city services, a free library card and more, from Chomedey to Vimont.

photo.credit: 1333 boulevard Chomedey · Photo: Laurent Bélanger, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Find your collection zone
slides.body: Search your address at **laval.ca/recherche-par-adresse**, then save your 2026 collection calendar.
slides.source: Per Ville de Laval, 2026 collection calendar

slides.title: Learn the bin timing

cards.title: After 7 p.m.
cards.sub: Or before 7 a.m. on pickup day

slides.body: In winter, the brown bin is often picked up **every two weeks**, depending on your housing type.

slides.title: Save 311 and open Mon dossier
slides.body: Outside Laval, dial 450-978-8000. Missing a bin? Request one through **Mon dossier**, the city's online account.

slides.title: Get your free library card
slides.body: Sign up in person at a Laval library, like **Sylvain-Garneau** in Sainte-Rose or **Philippe-Panneton** in Laval-Ouest.

slides.title: Big items have their own route

banner.text: Écocentre de Vimont · 1205 boul. Dagenais O.

slides.body: Paint, electronics and tires go to the écocentre. Old furniture? The city collects **bulky items** by reservation.

slides.title: New to Laval? Ask me anything.
slides.tagline: Think of me as the friend who happens to know Laval real estate.
